widget.name: Customized Date Range Picker
widget.description: Customizable date and time range picker for Mendix applications.

property.caption: Date range?
property.description: Enable selection of a start and end date.

property.caption: Start date attribute
property.description: DateTime attribute used for the selected date or start date.

property.caption: End date attribute
property.description: Configure this attribute when Date Range is enabled.

property.caption: Picker type
property.description: Choose the date or time selection mode.

property.caption: Placeholder text
property.description: Text displayed when no date is selected.

property.caption: Label caption
property.description: Label displayed above the picker.

property.caption: Show label
property.description: Display or hide the label.

property.caption: Clearable
property.description: Allow the selected dates to be cleared.

property.caption: Inline
property.description: Render the picker inline instead of in a popover.

property.caption: Editable
property.description: Allow the user to change the selected dates.

property.caption: Required
property.description: Require a start date. In range mode, both dates are required for a complete range.

property.caption: Time interval in minutes
property.description: Interval between selectable times, aligned from the beginning of each hour.

property.caption: Time format
property.description: Choose 12-hour or 24-hour time.

property.caption: Show week numbers
property.description: Display week numbers in the calendar.

property.caption: Minimum date
property.description: Expression returning the earliest selectable DateTime.

property.caption: Maximum date
property.description: Expression returning the latest selectable DateTime.

property.caption: Minimum time
property.description: Expression returning the earliest selectable time as a DateTime value.

property.caption: Maximum time
property.description: Expression returning the latest selectable time as a DateTime value.

property.caption: On enter
property.description: Action executed when the picker opens.

property.caption: On leave
property.description: Action executed when the picker closes.

property.caption: On change
property.description: Action executed when the selected date or time changes.

property.caption: Start date label
property.description: Label for the start date selection.

property.caption: End date label
property.description: Label for the end date selection.

property.caption: Today label
property.description: Label used in the date picker interface.

property.caption: Clear label
property.description: Accessible label for clearing the selected dates.
